answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking tied to attested work: every agent must lock collateral that only grows as peers countersign its genuine contributions. Sybil clones stay hollow, unable to mirror a real track record without each paying the full bond, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes. Honest agents climb toward the reputation summit cheaply, while an attacker faces a cost wall that scales linearly with every fake identity minted.
